verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state users can upload documents, spreadsheets, notebooks and more to get answers, summaries, and insights (gemini-docs-25), and Deep Research/NotebookLM flows support adding files from Drive/Gmail or direct uploads for research (gemini-docs-29, gemini-docs-47). Independent hands-on reports corroborate strong document/PDF analysis (fintech PDF OCR replacement at 96% accuracy, gemini-comm-17) and large-corpus comprehension via NotebookLM (gemini-comm-19), though some accuracy issues are noted elsewhere (e.g., bounding-box extraction failures, gemini-comm-18) that are adjacent but not central to this story. missing for 10: no dedicated first-party benchmark on spreadsheet-specific accuracy, and no controlled independent test of document analysis fidelity beyond anecdotal reports.
